name: Kaunertaler Gletscher
kurzbeschreibung: The Kaunertaler Gletscher thrills at up to 3,113 m altitude with snow-sure skiing, 100% barrier-free Falginjochbahn, and a walk-in glacier crevasse.
beschreibung:
Overview

The Kaunertaler Gletscher at the head of the Tyrolean Kaunertal valley is one of Austria's most spectacular high-alpine and glacier ski resorts. Nestled within the colossal mountain world of the Ötztaler Alpen at the foot of the Weißseespitze (3,518 m), the glacier ski area spans the extensive Weißseeferner from 2,150 metres up to a snow-reliable 3,113 metres above sea level at the Karlesjoch. Internationally, the resort sets benchmarks for lived sustainability and barrier-free accessibility: as a multi-award-winning monoski and handbike paradise, the glacier provides completely threshold-free access to all lifts and viewing viewpoints.

Glacier World, Falginjochbahn & Nature Experience

The tourism development of the Weißseeferner began in 1980 with the construction of the first T-bar lifts. Today, cutting-edge ropeway systems provide access to the glacier ice: an architectural milestone is the Falginjochbahn opened in 2019: the wind-stable 100-passenger Funifor gondola spans the route up to 3,108 metres entirely without support towers and is certified 100 percent barrier-free. From the viewing platform at the Karlesjoch (3,113 m), perched directly on the national border between Austria and Italy, visitors enjoy the famous Dreiländerblick across the peaks of Austria, Italy, and Switzerland stretching to the glaciated Ortler (3,905 m) and the Berninagruppe. In summer, the approximately 40-metre-long Begehbare Gletscherspalte (walk-in glacier crevasse) right at the Weißseeferner captivates visitors: guests walk safely through the interior of the glacier, marvelling at centuries-old, deep-blue shimmering glacier ice and bizarre ice crystals. For geology and nature enthusiasts, the glacier educational trail provides insights into alpine climate and glacier retreat.

Visit & Getting There

The Kaunertaler Gletscher offers ski operations from early October to late May; in summer, the cable cars operate for pedestrians and excursionists from mid-June to mid-September daily from 09:00 to 16:00. Tariffs summer 2025/2026: Karlesjochbahn round trip adults €29.00, children €17.00; entry to the glacier crevasse is included free of charge in the cable car ticket! When arriving by private car, the toll for the Kaunertaler Gletscherstraße is included with the purchase of a cable car ticket. Arrival by car: from Landeck via the Reschenstraße B180 to Prutz, then along the L18 into the Kaunertal and further via the toll road Kaunertaler Gletscherstraße directly to the glacier restaurant at 2,750 metres. By public transport: ÖBB to Landeck-Zams station, from there take Postbus line 230 directly to Kaunertaler Gletscher.

Tips

The entire area, including the glacier restaurant, sun terrace, gondolas, and Karlesjoch viewing platform, is exemplarily barrier-free and fully wheelchair accessible. Even in midsummer, wear sturdy, warm shoes and weatherproof clothing, as temperatures inside the glacier crevasse remain at a constant 0 °C. Combine your excursion with a stop at the historic Gepatschhaus.
oeffnungszeiten: Sommerbetrieb Mitte Juni bis Mitte Sep tgl. 09:00–16:00 Uhr; Skibetrieb Okt–Mai tgl. 08:30–16:00 Uhr
